decision: white text counts as invisible only when the topmost painted thing under it is light; images and dark fills protect it
why: deleting white text on a dark banner would remove visible content

decision: removed text shows are replaced by a glyph-free TJ advance when font widths are known
why: following text on the same line must not shift; proven by the pixel test on mixed_line.pdf

decision: Tr 7 (clip-only) text is left alone
why: it does not paint but it clips later drawing, so deleting it can change what is visible

decision: metadata policy: drop non-standard Info keys and XMP namespaces always; drop standard text fields only when they look like instructions or opaque tracking tokens
why: clears marker fields without inventing values and without flagging every Word export
